svg.title: assembly-qc-processing: male chrX/chrY duplicates between the haplotypes
svg.desc: A male sample's X- and Y-assigned contigs from both haplotypes laid over a reference X and Y. Spans assembled twice are marked; a contig is dropped only when the other haplotype covers it, aligns at identity 0.9999 or better, and the uncovered remainder is at most 20 kb, an absolute bound, not a fraction. Survivors are regrouped: Y to hap1, X to hap2.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ①+② but over the 20 kb → kept, PARTIAL (uncovered bp reported) · ① without ② → kept, DIVERGENT (paralogues) · PAR-dominated → SKIP_PAR · nothing is ever trimmed

svg.text: hap1's copy at the end of X is 92% covered by hap2's shorter copy. A fractional rule (≥ 90%) drops hap1's — it is the copy outside X's home haplotype —

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: and the 1.9 Mb only it carries then exists nowhere. The absolute rule keeps it (1.9 Mb ≫ 20 kb) and drops hap2's short copy instead:

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: it lies entirely inside hap1's, at identity ≥ 0.9999, with nothing left over.

svg.text: regroup: Y → hap1, X → hap2 · ledger actions DROP, MOVE (source) and ADD (destination) · check_step.py verifies each ADD against the other haplotype's input

svg.text: mode: report writes the call tables only; mode: apply publishes the regrouped haplotypes, which the processed QC then reads. Sex is called from chrY-aligned Mb over both haplotypes; a female passes through untouched.
